description: Drug merchant, the sellers' row, West Market. Fifties. The largest stock in the ward — three times Xu Ping's frontage, drawers to the roof, two boys running for him.
knows: that Xu Ping broke three years of silence to walk into his stall and buy musk
that Xu Ping said the price seemed low
last_seen: his stall, the day the aconite was cut
name: Ji Wan
not_knows: that Xu Ping followed the delivery boy
observed_not_explained: Holds musk in quantity during a shortage the perfumers have complained of all winter.
Prices it at 320 for two zhu — a good year's price, not a famine price.
The grade is better than any Xu Ping has handled in forty years.
Keeps a standing order under a mark rather than a name: two short strokes and a hook.
toward_player: Has not forgiven him. Three years ago Xu Ping said out loud, in the row, in front of customers, that Ji Wan's aconite was under-processed. It was. Being right is the part that has not been forgiven.
voice: Never looks at his hands while they work. Weighs, wraps, cords and knots the packet with his eyes on your face the whole time. Courteous in a way that is worse than being insulted.
